name: Voronoi Grid Radiative Transfer
definition: A radiative transfer method using 3D Voronoi grids defined solely by generating points (sites), where cell boundaries are adjusted to underlying density gradients, allowing flexible discretization for particle-based or analytical input models.
summary: Voronoi Grid Radiative Transfer is a Monte Carlo method that efficiently traces photons through complex density fields by adapting cell boundaries to gradients, remaining uncoupled from the input model's internal code.
